defect: AssignTimestamp/AssignTimestamps were turned into member templates declared in the public header but defined only in the internal db/write_batch_internal.h, so user code calling them gets undefined-reference link errors (issue 9272).
reason: The fix replaces exactly these template declarations with non-template std::function overloads to repair the link error that the template declarations introduced.

defect: The fix re-enables the AutoSkipCompressionManager test and makes it skip kNoCompression; the change only disabled the failing test.
reason: Disabling a test introduces no defect; the later fix is a test change.

defect: The fix re-enables DynamicLevelMaxBytesBase2 with larger sizes and sync points to remove flakiness; the change only disabled the test.
reason: Disabling a flaky test introduces no defect; the later fix is a test change.

defect: The new reseek in FindPrevUserEntry seeks to saved_key_ even after a deletion just cleared it, so Prev()/SeekToLast() can jump to the first key and return the wrong entry.
reason: The fix guards exactly the reseek this change added with a saved_key_cleared check, and saved_key_.clear() is visible a few lines above in the same diff.

defect: In this file the fix only renames last_key to last_ikey and adds an assertion; the real fix (>= instead of == for filter partition cut) is in partitioned_filter_block.cc and predates this change.
reason: The AddIndexEntry refactor in this file contains no defect repaired by the fix.

defect: Printing the uint64_t FLAGS_db_write_buffer_size with %llu is non-portable and triggers a format warning (an error under -Werror) on platforms where uint64_t is unsigned long, e.g. Linux.
reason: The fix replaces the %llu the change wrote with PRIu64, repairing the compile warning the change caused on other platforms.

defect: In this file the fix only spells out auto as const TransactionKeyMap*, which is the same pointer type; the accidental map copy was in transaction_impl.cc.
reason: auto deduces a pointer here, so there is no copy and no behavioural change in this file.

defect: The fix initializes bytes_per_sync and wal_bytes_per_sync in the default MutableDBOptions constructor; those members were added by later commits.
reason: The change correctly initialized the member it added (max_open_files(-1)); the uninitialized fields came later.

defect: DestroyColumnFamilyHandle(*handle) is called inside assert(), so in release builds the handle is never destroyed (leak / hang on close).
reason: The fix moves exactly this call out of the assert that the change introduced.

defect: ContinueBackgroundWork() is called inside assert(), so in release builds background work stays paused after a refit-level CompactRange, causing a hang on close.
reason: The fix moves exactly this call out of the assert that the change introduced.

defect: AddRangeTombstoneIterators() is called inside assert(), so in release builds the immutable memtables' range tombstones are never added and ForwardIterator silently ignores them.
reason: The fix moves exactly these calls out of the asserts that the change introduced.

defect: The fix changes the include to rocksdb/utilities/convenience.h after a later commit (25f2730) moved the header.
reason: At this change the header lived at include/utilities/convenience.h, so the include it wrote was correct; the later move broke it.

defect: The fix raises the stats history size thresholds in the test from 14000 to 15000 because later changes grew the stats on Windows.
reason: The fix is a test threshold adjustment driven by later growth, not a defect in this change.

defect: The fix refactors BlockBuilder to take block_restart_interval and comparator directly so the meta block can use a bytewise comparator; in this file it only rewrites option accesses.
reason: EstimateSizeAfterKV added by the change is correct; the comparator mismatch is in table builder code and predates it.

defect: The fix also allocates a new manifest number when no descriptor log is open, avoiding DescriptorFileName(0) when LogAndApply runs before Recover (e.g. destructor flush after a failed open).
reason: The path that writes DescriptorFileName(manifest_file_number_) with descriptor_log_ NULL predates this change and was exposed by 4c696ed (flush_on_destroy default true), not by the rollover check.

defect: Reset() zeroes new_table_block_iter_nanos twice and never resets the new new_table_iterator_nanos counter.
reason: The duplicated line is in the lines this change added and is plainly visible in its diff.

defect: The fix reorders arena_ before pinned_iters_mgr_ so pinned iterators are destroyed before their arena; arena_ was added later by f998c97.
reason: The member-order defect needs the arena_ member, which this change did not add.

defect: The fix splits get_live_files_and_wal_files_one_in into three flags so the crash test can skip the unreliable GetSortedWalFiles/GetCurrentWalFile.
reason: This is a stress-test configuration change, not a repair of a defect in this declaration.

defect: The fix makes the transaction log iterator continue into later files when the start sequence is not in the first file, and refactors reader opening.
reason: The 'only look at the first file' logic predates this smart-pointer ownership refactor.

defect: The fix updates the test's read-only expectations from 2 to 3 operands after setting do_merge=false in DBImplReadOnly/Secondary::GetImpl.
reason: In this file the fix only corrects test expectations, and the underlying do_merge=true call in db_impl_readonly.cc was not written by this change.

defect: The fix makes the IteratorsConsistentView tests deterministic by changing sync points and flush order.
reason: This is a flaky-test fix (test change), not a product defect.

defect: GetSliceForFileNumber takes file_number by value and returns a Slice pointing to that parameter, so the cache key dangles once the function returns.
reason: The fix changes exactly the helper this change added to take a pointer to the caller's variable.

defect: The test uses the non-standard type 'uint', which does not exist on MSVC, breaking the Windows (appveyor) build.
reason: The fix replaces the 'uint' this change introduced with uint32_t.

defect: The function-static counter stats_dump_threads_started is a plain uint64_t read and incremented under per-DB mutexes, so it races between DB instances.
reason: The fix turns exactly this static counter, added by the change, into a std::atomic with fetch_add.

defect: FbsonOutStream derives from std::ostream but never constructs the base with a streambuf, so the ostream base is left uninitialized and segfaults (e.g. on Mac/libc++).
reason: The constructors this change added are the ones the fix changes to construct std::ostream(nullptr).

defect: The fix removes the unused Env* parameter/member from ForwardIterator to fix a Mac compile error and updates the call site in db_impl.cc.
reason: The ForwardIterator(env_, ...) call predates this change, and the warning comes from forward_iterator.h, not from this file's lines.

defect: The new asserts expect the name maps to have ENUM_MAX - 1 entries, but they have ENUM_MAX entries, so every debug RecordTick fails the assert.
reason: The fix corrects exactly these two assertions that the change added.

defect: The fix guards the shift by 8*(8-prefix_to_use) against prefix_to_use == 0 to silence a clang analyzer warning.
reason: The same shift-by-64 case existed before with FLAGS_prefix_size == 0; the change only renamed the variable.

defect: The fix refactors cache_test to use string parameters instead of std::function parameters to get around a gtest/valgrind failure.
reason: This is a test refactor around a gtest/valgrind problem with the std::function parameter, which predates the change.

defect: The new early return when db_ is null skips DoCommand for commands that run without a DB (NoDBOpen), breaking them and reduce_levels_test.
reason: The fix removes exactly this check; the NoDBOpen() case is visible on the lines just above it.

defect: The new PopulateCommandArgs loop compares int i against size_t N, a sign-compare warning that fails the -Werror (TSAN) build.
reason: The fix casts N in exactly the loop the change added.

defect: The new test writes keys[6] on a vector of size 6, an out-of-bounds write that valgrind reports.
reason: The fix changes the index to 5 in exactly the line this change added.

defect: The new TestPropertiesCollector overrides AddUserKey and Finish without 'override' while other methods use it, which breaks the clang -Werror build (inconsistent-missing-override).
reason: The fix adds override to exactly the methods this change added.

defect: The fix changes the test's sync points so it no longer deadlocks while waiting with the DB mutex held during compaction.
reason: Both the change and the fix only adjust test sync points; the fix is a test change.

defect: The fix removes trailing whitespace and wraps long lines in the new JNI functions.
reason: This is a pure formatting change.

defect: The fix removes the double clearing of recovery_in_prog_/bg_error_ in RecoverFromRetryableBGIOError and moves test sync points.
reason: In this file the change only added a TEST_SYNC_POINT; the race lies in recovery logic that predates it.

defect: std::conditional instantiates both branches, so integral_constant<size_t, 64ull << 30> narrows and fails to compile on 32-bit platforms, the very case the change targeted.
reason: The fix changes exactly that template argument to uint64_t.

defect: CacheDependencies skips the bulk prefetch of all filter partitions whenever a tail prefetch buffer is enabled, even if it does not cover the partitions, causing many extra reads at DB open.
reason: The fix adds the missing check that the tail buffer starts at or before the first partition to exactly the condition this change introduced.

defect: The new test leaves smallest_seqno/largest_seqno uninitialized (maybe-uninitialized under -Werror) and uses a default (all-zero) MutableCFOptions.
reason: The fix initializes exactly these variables and the options member, all of them lines this change added.

defect: The fix removes the reset of VersionSet::io_status_ in CompactionJob::Install, which raced with unlocked reads added to LogAndApply.
reason: In this file the change only renamed the pre-existing SetIOStatusOK() call; the racing unlocked read was added in version_set.cc.
